messages:
harper: FYI a user hit a nasty edge-only TS inference bug in the quickstart. works in node but Vercel/Cloudflare build shows tons of 'any' after calling sdk.generate with a parse fn.

noah: can you drop the callsite and our overloads?

harper: callsite: `const out = await sdk.generate({model:'r1', parse: s => JSON.parse(s)})` our d.ts has two overloads — one returns string, the other generic T.

rei: bundlers + `type: module` pick the ESM entry. if our ESM .d.ts orders overloads differently, TS might pick the non-generic version.

harper: exactly. their package.json has "type":"module" and Vite uses esbuild -> bundler resolution. result: callers get Promise<any> or string and lose inferred T.

noah: quick fixes: 1) collapse to a single generic with `T = unknown` 2) publish per-entry types in exports so ESM consumers see matching .d.ts 3) add a tsc job in CI that runs with `moduleResolution: 'bundler'` and `module: 'ES2022'`.

rei: +1. also avoid overloads where possible; they bite in cross-build setups. we should update quickstart tsconfig docs rather than telling users to use skipLibCheck.

docs-bot: opened docs PR to add a note about "type: module" and bundler resolution impacts on d.ts selection: https://docs.redwood/typing-edge-friction

ci-bot: sample-quickstart / typecheck failed on branch fix/esm-types (logs: https://ci.redwood/999/log).

harper: i'll send a small patch: replace overloads with `export function generate<T = string>(opts: {model:string; parse?: (s:string)=>T}): Promise<T>;` and add "types":"./dist/esm/index.d.ts" to exports import entry. running local repro now.

noah: please add the tsc Vite matrix to CI. i'll review the PR. trying to avoid user-facing runtime changes.

harper: thanks — keeping this thread as tracker. will ping when PR and beta are published.
